data.name: Halfhearted Challenge
data.description: Sisters-in-arms vigilantly protect their allies, weakening their focus on their challenged foe. A sister-in-arms adds only half her cavalier level (minimum 1) to damage rolls against her challenge target. This ability alters challenge.
